question: Who among the following musicians was a member of Navratnas of Akbar?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Tansen**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tansen** was one of the **Navratnas** (Nine Gems) in the court of the Mughal Emperor **Akbar**.
 
• He is considered one of the greatest composers and musicians in Indian history and played a significant role in shaping Hindustani classical music.
 
• **Tansen** was born in **Gwalior**, Madhya Pradesh, and trained under the renowned musician **Swami Haridas**.
 
• He joined Akbar's court and was honored for his extraordinary musical talent.
 
• **Tansen's compositions** have a profound influence on Indian classical music. He is credited with composing several **ragas**, including **Miyan ki Todi, Miyan ki Malhar**, and **Miyan ki Sarang**.
 
• His singing was believed to have magical effects, such as causing rain or even lighting lamps through specific ragas.
 
• He was a master of the **Drupad style** of singing and is often referred to as the father of Hindustani classical music.
 
• **Tansen's mausoleum** is located in **Gwalior**, and it continues to attract music lovers and historians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nizamuddin Auliya**__

 __
 
• **Nizamuddin Auliya** was a prominent **Sufi saint** of the Chishti Order in India.
 
• He lived during the reign of several rulers, including **Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq**, but he was not associated with Akbar's court.
 
• His teachings emphasized love, humility, and service to humanity.
 
• His shrine, **Nizamuddin Dargah**, in Delhi, is a famous pilgrimage site.
 
 
 
• **Amir Khusrao**__
 
 
• **Amir Khusrao** was a celebrated Persian poet, musician, and scholar who lived during the reign of the Delhi Sultanate, not Akbar.
 
• He is considered the father of **Qawwali** and made significant contributions to Indian classical music and literature.
 
• He was associated with **Nizamuddin Auliya** and wrote in Persian, Hindavi, and other languages.
 
• Amir Khusrao's works include poetry, riddles, and ghazals, and he is credited with the invention of the **sitar**.
